about: the SWOT repeat period and overpass track identity, in the knowledge base
text: No page read for this question states the repeat period of the science orbit, and the fixture has no pass number (the drafted fixture page, not signed, says so). I first grouped passes with a period supplied from memory, 20.86455 d, which the read-what-is-known skill does not allow as a fact. The file itself shows intervals between passes of one track with median 20.86464 d, and a grouping from the gaps alone agrees with the phase grouping on every pass once the missing pass of 2024-03-25 is allowed for. A page that states the repeat, or a fixture that keeps pass_id, would remove the inference.
from: an exploration: what it says was seen while exploring and is not a tested claim
